MESA ECOSYSTEM

From sources to memory.
From memory to applications.

Five repositories split the work into preparation, memory, application, behavior testing, and independent evidence. Their boundaries are part of the design.

THE TEN-SECOND MAP

One delivery chain.
Two quality layers.

MESA Data prepares reviewed legal releases. Core owns the memory lifecycle. MESA Law consumes Core over HTTP. QA and E2E Certification evaluate behavior and evidence without becoming runtime dependencies.

SOURCESOfficial legal data
→
PREPAREMESA Data
→
MEMORYMESA Core
→
APPLICATIONMESA Law
VERIFY THE CHAINMESA QA+E2E Certification

FIVE EXPLICIT ROLES

Simple first.
Technical when needed.

Open each technical role for detail, then follow the dedicated page or source repository.

01

The memory layer

MESA Core

Accepts authorized information and makes it retrievable without dropping its evidence or data scope.

Technical role

Owns the V4 catalog, authorization, mutation lifecycle, projections, retrieval, API, SDK, and MCP surfaces.

Explore Core →Repository ↗
02

The source preparation layer

MESA Data

Turns reviewed Turkish legal sources into traceable releases that MESA Core can admit.

Technical role

Preserves raw bytes, canonicalizes records, applies quality gates, freezes releases, and uses a human-started publisher.

Explore Data →Repository ↗
03

The behavior testing layer

MESA QA

Checks whether candidate builds remember, update, forget, and recover as expected over time.

Technical role

Exercises correctness, temporal change, cross-session persistence, restart durability, and bounded candidate repair.

Explore QA →Repository ↗
04

The evidence and verdict layer

MESA Certification

Defines what one end-to-end legal profile must prove before a passing result can be claimed.

Technical role

Uses frozen evidence, independent ground truth, hard gates, and fail-closed Profile B verdicts.

Explore Certification →Repository ↗
05

The application layer

MESA Law

Shows how a legal matter and document workflow can consume MESA through an explicit service boundary.

Technical role

Adds review, provenance, deadlines, drafting controls, and a pinned MESA V4 HTTP contract.

Explore Law →Repository ↗

END-TO-END EXAMPLE

Legal evidence,
kept connected.

A reviewed legal source can move through a frozen Data release, authorized Core admission, scoped retrieval, and a Law workflow without presenting local staging or a 202 response as successful publication.

  1. 01AcquireApproved or manual official source
  2. 02ReleaseImmutable evidence and canonical records
  3. 03AdmitAuthorized dataset-scoped mutation
  4. 04RetrieveRanked context with provenance
  5. 05UseLaw workflow over the HTTP contract
